source_utterance: When a row in my lead tracker becomes READY, prepare a reviewable email draft once; never send it automatically.
intent: For each lead row whose status changes to READY, create one Gmail draft for the owner to review. Never send.
trigger: scheduled poll (time-driven installable trigger, runs as its creator, timing is approximate)
predicate: status == READY and consent == YES and email present and row_id not already processed
transformation: pure function: row -> {to, subject, body} from the approved template version
permissions: spreadsheets.readonly on the one tracker sheet
gmail.compose (draft creation), to be verified against current scope list
idempotency: row unique ID + template version stored after successful draft creation; reconcile partial failures before retry
failure_policy: log metadata only, stop on schema mismatch, bounded retry (3) on transient failure, alert owner on stop
audit_log: append-only audit sheet: row_id, template_version, outcome, timestamp; no message content
data_retention: audit rows kept 90 days; no email bodies stored outside Gmail
quota: Gmail draft and trigger runtime quotas rechecked at deployment; batch size capped at 20 rows per run
disable: remove installable trigger and set PAUSED flag in Script Properties
tests: failure between side effect and receipt
missing_critical_facts: exact column names of the tracker sheet
